999008199.text: レスナたちはどのくらいこの国に留まる予定なの？

localizations.en: How long are you and your friends planning to stay in Nova?

999008199.text:
ロマンさんが、ランターナとこの国の国交再開に向けて
話し合いをしてるみたいだから……

localizations.en: Well, Roman is negotiating to restablish diplomatic relations between Lantarna and Nova...

999008199.text: 少なくとも、それが纏まるまでは滞在するかな

localizations.en: So we'll probably stay until that's settled, at least.

999008199.text:
ロマンさんって王子様……なんだっけ？
王子自ら海を渡って来るなんてすごいね

localizations.en: Roman is a prince, right? It's pretty amazing that a prince would cross the sea himself.

999008199.text: ロマンは王子でもあるけど、冒険者でもあるから

localizations.en: Roman may be a prince, but he's also an adventurer.

999008199.text:
そういえば、最初会った時もそんな話してたっけ
危なくないの？

localizations.en: Come to think of it, you mentioned that when we first met. Wouldn't that be dangerous?

999008199.text: アタシたち騎士がしっかり見張ってるから大丈夫！

localizations.en: There's nothing to worry about! We knights are keeping a close eye on him!

999008199.text: 大事なものを護る。私たち聖戦士と同じね

localizations.en: You have a duty to protect... just like us Sacred Knights.

999008199.text:
ただ天命に定められたわけではないのよね。
どういう過程で騎士になったのかしら？

localizations.en: Though I supposed it wasn't predetermined by the stars. How did you become a knight, anyway?

999008199.text:
自分がなりたいから目指しただけだよ。
大変だったけど、この間やっと試験に受かったんだ

localizations.en: I just wanted to be one, that's all! It was tough, but I finally passed the exam recently.

999008199.text: 本当に、自分で道を……

localizations.en: You truly are free to choose your own path...

999008199.text:
アタシ、元々は鍛冶屋の娘でさ。
家の仕事を継ぐ道もあったけど、こっちを選んだの

localizations.en: I'm actually a blacksmith's daughter. I could've taken over the family business, but I chose to become a knight instead.

999008199.text:
もし自分が選んだ道が、星が定めていない道だとしたら
神様に見放されてしまうのでは……

localizations.en: If the path you chose wasn't the one the stars had ordained... wouldn't you fear being forsaken by the gods?

999008199.text: 私だったら、そんな風に考えてしまうわ

localizations.en: That's what would come to mind for us, at least.

999008199.text:
ふーん。考えたことなかった。
こういうの、文化の違いっていうのかな

localizations.en: Hmm. I've never really thought about it that way. Perhaps this is what they call cultural differences?

999008199.text:
星への感謝と尊敬を忘れないノーヴァ神聖国の教えも、
とっても素敵だと思います

localizations.en: I think Nova's teachings about respecting and being grateful to the stars are wonderful.

999008199.text:
でも、ランターナがそうだったなら、私は今のように
大陸を飛び出して、夢を追うことはできなかったのかも

localizations.en: But if Lantarna were like that, I probably wouldn't have been able to leave the continent to chase my dreams like I am doing now.

999008199.text: ……辛くはない？

もちろん、辛いこともありますけどね。
でも、自分の信じた道ですから

localizations.en: Of course it gets hard sometimes. But it's also the path I believe in.
